_metadata.description: Serve the Act denominator through the shared space verb, report the live binding numerator, and audit the denominator once the numerator exists.

requirements.title: Act projection ownership
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MUST serve the Act denominator through the shared space projection verb.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/actspace/space_test.go::TestServesActDenominator` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-007]). The shared space projection verb returns the Act denominator parsed from docs/spaces/act-space.md.

Target `api/internal/actspace/space_test.go::TestMatchesSpacedocContract` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-007]). Output satisfies the shared spacedoc contract meta-optimization-manager reads, including denominator confidence.

requirements.title: Act numerator registry RPC
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MUST expose a binding-registry RPC that reports, per Act operation class, whether every operation it names resolves to a manifest-bound governed binding, so meta-optimization-manager computes the Act numerator live and never stores it.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/actspace/numerator_test.go::TestReportsPerCellBindingResolution` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-008]). The registry RPC reports, per Act operation class, whether every named operation resolves to a governed binding.

Target `api/internal/actspace/numerator_test.go::TestPartiallyBoundCellIsInReach` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-008]). A cell whose operations are only partially bound reports in-reach rather than covered.

Target `api/internal/actspace/numerator_test.go::TestUnresolvableCellKeepsAuthoredStatus` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-008]). A cell that cannot be resolved keeps its authored status and is never fabricated as missing.

requirements.title: Act denominator audit
requirements.description: Once the binding-registry numerator is live, the Program Runtime SHOULD audit every Act denominator cell against the resolved registry and raise the stated denominator confidence above SKETCH, so Act coverage on the readiness board is measured rather than authored.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/actspace/audit_test.go::TestEveryCellResolvesAgainstLiveRegistry` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-009]). Every operation named by an Act cell resolves to a decided registry verdict — bound, unbound with a stated reason, or unresolvable — so no cell keeps an unaudited authoring judgment.

Target `api/internal/actspace/audit_test.go::TestConfidenceReflectsAuditCoverage` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-009]). The served denominator confidence is derived from the share of audited cells and cannot report above SKETCH while unaudited cells remain.

Target `api/internal/actspace/audit_test.go::TestEveryCellResolvesAgainstLiveRegistry` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P1-009]). The complete 28-cell denominator is audited against the live registry and every cell receives a decided verdict with explicit unresolved reasons where applicable.
